metadata.title: ESRI Data Maps United States, 2009-2010
metadata.description: This collection comprises 60 Shapefile layers from ESRI Data Maps 10 (United States), a comprehensive vector reference dataset distributed with ArcGIS 10. The layers cover geographic, administrative, and infrastructural features of the United States, organized across four categories. Hydrology layers include drainage systems, rivers and streams, water bodies, National Atlas water feature lines and areas, lakes, and rivers. Census and demographic layers include census block groups and centroid populations, census tracts, core based statistical areas, counties, states, populated place areas and points, urbanized areas, congressional districts, ZIP code areas and points, telephone area code boundaries, and cities. Landmark layers include parks, major parks, recreation areas, large area landmarks, institutions, federal and Indian land areas, federal land lines, Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) features (buildings, cemeteries, churches, golf locales, hospitals, locales, populated places, schools, summits), National Atlas historic earthquakes, and National Atlas volcanoes. Transportation layers include airports, highways, interstate highways, major roads, railroads, and transportation terminals. Additional reference layers include state plane zones (NAD 1927 and NAD 1983), a National Atlas public land survey, and USGS topographic quadrangle series indexes at 1:24,000, 1:100,000, and 1:250,000 scales. For the 2010 U.S. National Atlas Water Feature Lines and 110th Congressional Districts records, only the WGS84 projected files are available.
